entities.name: Òscar Ribas Reig
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Òscar Ribas Reig was an Andorran politician, lawyer, and businessman who became the first prime minister of Andorra in 1982. He twice served as head of government, first from 8 January 1982 to 21 May 1984 and again from 12 January 1990 to 7 December 1994.
